# function: secret_value

Reads public KVs from an mgcl Secret through the `mgcl run` provider API.

- `provider::mgcl::secret_value("app-config/region")` returns the string value of one public KV.
- `provider::mgcl::secret_value("team/app-config/*")` returns a `map(string)` of every public KV in that Secret. An empty public set returns an empty map.

Secret names may contain multiple `/`-separated segments; the reference is split at the last `/` and the key is always a single segment without `/`.

> **Warning:** the result is normal, non-sensitive data. OpenTofu can persist it in plan files, state and logs. Use this function only for KVs explicitly marked public with `mgcl secret set <name>/<key> --public`. For ephemeral KVs, use the `mgcl_secret` ephemeral resource.

Public KV values are encrypted at rest in `mgcl.db`; this function does not make the result confidential once OpenTofu has evaluated it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The result is ordinary, non-sensitive data: OpenTofu may persist it in plan
# files, state, and logs. Use secret_value only for KVs marked public.
resource "terraform_data" "public_region" {
  input = provider::mgcl::secret_value("app-config/region")
}

resource "terraform_data" "public_config" {
  input = provider::mgcl::secret_value("app-config/*")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
secret_value(reference string) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `reference` (String) `<secret-name>/<key>` for one public KV, or `<secret-name>/*` for all public KVs. The name is One or more `/`-separated non-empty segments; each segment must equal its `url.PathEscape` form, and the whole name is at most 64 bytes including slashes. Uppercase letters, `.`, `..`, leading `-` or `_`, and other path-safe characters are allowed; characters that `url.PathEscape` encodes (for example spaces, `%`, `?`, `#`, and non-ASCII) are not. The key is A bare KV key: non-empty, at most 64 bytes, and equal to its `url.PathEscape` form, so it cannot contain `/`. Uppercase letters, `.`, `..`, leading `-` or `_`, and other path-safe characters are allowed; characters that `url.PathEscape` encodes (for example spaces, `%`, `?`, `#`, and non-ASCII) are not.
